tokens.wrapper: US broker-dealer issued, backed 1:1 by a real share held in a Backpack Securities brokerage account
tokens.redemptionPath: Redeemable for the underlying stock; transferable to a traditional brokerage via ACATS
tokens.dividends: Cash dividends and corporate actions passed to holders
tokens.riskNotes: Holder has a share redemption right rather than a cash equivalent. Tokens move freely between wallets during the on-chain phase; conversion back to traditional shares goes through Backpack Securities. Listed on Solana the same day SpaceX began trading on Nasdaq, June 2026.

tokens.wrapper: Tokenized tracker certificate issued out of a Liechtenstein-domiciled SPV, collateralised by shares held at qualified custodians
tokens.redemptionPath: Only qualified, KYC-verified, non-US investors can mint or redeem. A retail holder has no direct redemption line to the underlying share; exit is by selling on-chain.
tokens.dividends: Passed via a rebasing mechanism using the Token-2022 Scaled UI Amount Config extension, and as USDC airdrops net of withholding
tokens.attestation: Backed publishes a monthly attestation comparing custodied share count to on-chain token supply
tokens.jurisdiction: Liechtenstein (SPV supervised by the FMA); custody at institutions including Clearstream Banking and InCore Bank
tokens.riskNotes: Retail cannot redeem. The claim runs against the SPV rather than against a share registered in the holder's name. Price is held to the underlying by arbitrage from qualified participants, not by a retail redemption right.

tokens.wrapper: Structured note, a debt instrument, issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited, a bankruptcy-remote SPV
tokens.redemptionPath: Peer-to-peer transfers run around the clock; minting and redemption follow traditional market hours. Retail eligibility to mint or redeem is not verified.
tokens.riskNotes: This is a debt instrument, not a share and not a claim on a share. The holder takes credit exposure to the issuing SPV. Bankruptcy-remote structuring limits, but does not remove, that exposure.

tokens.wrapper: Synthetic pre-IPO exposure. No public underlying during the pre-IPO phase.
tokens.redemptionPath: Post-listing the token must be manually swapped into the public-stock equivalent, split-adjusted for the 5-for-1 split, by midnight UTC on 12 March 2027. Tokens not swapped by that deadline expire worthless.
tokens.lockup: Carried a 180-day lockup before conversion to real shares, which was not widely understood by buyers.
tokens.attestation: PreStocks stated it would issue regular external audit reports and, as of reporting, had not done so. Third-party attestation reports were described as a work in progress.
tokens.riskNotes: The token traded at roughly a 40% discount to the underlying after buyers discovered the 180-day lockup. There is a hard expiry: unswapped tokens expire worthless. No delivered third-party attestation.
